meta.title: Fresh Green Skin
meta.description: Fresh green palette with custom wallpapers (image or video), wallpaper-derived colours, adaptive veil, fonts and named themes
meta.detail: Settings → General → Wallpaper: pick the bundled 4K photo, upload your own image or video, tune the transparency, derive colours from the wallpaper or pick your own, change the font, and save combinations as named themes switchable with Ctrl+Alt+number.
